messages.body_plain:
Hi Charlie,

I hope your move and job hunting has been a success. Do you have any firmer 
idea of when you might have time for another release of tikzDevice? 

On Tuesday, 17 July 2012 04:53:15 UTC+1, Charlie Sharpsteen wrote:
>
> On Mon, Jul 16, 2012 at 12:04 PM, <xlco... at mirai-solutions.ch<javascript:>> 
> wrote: 
>
> > Dear tikzDevice maintainers, 
> > 
> > first of all, thank you for this wonderful package. We're the 
> maintainers 
> > of the XLConnect package and were recently contacted (amongst others) by 
> > the CRAN maintainers to remove references to the tikzDevice package 
> since 
> > it has been removed from CRAN. We then found the current 0.6.3 release 
> on 
> > r-forge which seems to fix some of the issues the CRAN guys were talking 
> > about - only missing thing may be the .Rinstignore file as suggested by 
> R 
> > 2.15.1 R CMD check procedure. Are there any plans from your side to 
> > release a new version of the tikzDevice pacakge to CRAN in the near 
> > future? 
> > 
> > Thanks and Best regards, 
> > Martin 
> > 
>
> Hi, 
>
> The development version of tiikzDevice does contain fixes for the issues 
> that caused the package to be archived. Unfortunately, the development 
> version also contains a lot of material that has not been properly tested 
> and is therefore unsuitable for a CRAN release. 
>
> I just got back from an extended vacation and am currently in the process 
> of moving to Portland so I don't really have the free time to prep a CRAN 
> release at the moment---house and job hunting has to come first. I tried 
> to 
> explain this to the CRAN maintainers but they decided to archive the 
> package anyway. 
>
> I should have a new release ready around the beginning of August. Many 
> apologies to everyone who has been affected by this turn of events. 
>
> -Charlie 
> _______________________________________________ 
> Tikzdevice-bugs mailing list 
> Tikzdev... at lists.r-forge.r-project.org <javascript:> 
>
> https://lists.r-forge.r-project.org/cgi-bin/mailman/listinfo/tikzdevice-bugs 
>

On Wednesday, September 26, 2012 9:27:30 AM UTC-5, Alastair Andrew wrote:
>
> Hi Charlie,
>
> I hope your move and job hunting has been a success. Do you have any 
> firmer idea of when you might have time for another release of tikzDevice? 
>

Hi Alastair,

Unfortunately, I don't have a firm idea of when a release will happen. 
Getting version 0.7 released is still one of the top items on my todo list, 
but other things keep getting in the way. It will happen as soon as I can 
get a block of free time big enough to go through the QA checklist on 
Windows, Linux, OS X and Solaris.

That being said, the development builds of the package are still available 
from R-Forge:

    install.packages('filehash')
    install.packages('tikzDevice', repos = 'http://r-forge.r-project.org')

-Charlie
